column_description: Unique identifier for each access event.
Reference to the node being accessed. may be NULL.
Reference to the user accessing the node. may be NULL.
Date when the node was accessed. may be NULL.
Type of access (e.g., view, edit). always exactly one of 'view', 'edit'. may be NULL.
Timestamp for when the access log entry was created. may be NULL.
IP address of the user accessing the node. may be NULL.
User agent string of the client accessing the node. may be NULL.
